data.explanation: This is your final electricity settlement (Schlussrechnung) after moving out of Lindenweg 12. It covers extra consumption of 212 kWh plus the base price for the period, totaling 105.58 EUR including VAT. The bill states the amount is due within 30 days of the invoice date shown on the document, with no deduction allowed — pay by the deadline shown to avoid late payment issues. Keep this invoice for your records; utility bills like this can sometimes be relevant if you work from home, though this one doesn't indicate that.
